hook.headline: The front page ends. The feed never does.

stance.body: Void News publishes 50 stories a day, ranked once, in one order. When you reach the bottom, you are finished. No refresh, no infinite scroll, no algorithm feeding you one more.

posts.caption_instagram:
A newspaper had a last page. You could finish it, fold it, and go on with your day. Feeds removed the ending on purpose; an ending is where you leave.

Void News brings the ending back. Fifty stories, ranked once a day by how widely each one is covered, in the same order for every reader. When you reach story 50, the news is over.

No accounts. No infinite scroll. No algorithm deciding you need one more.

See through the void.

news.voidvision.org
#VoidNews #MediaBias #NewsLiteracy #SlowNews #FrontPage #NoAlgorithm

hook.headline: Every reader. Same fifty stories. Same order.

stance.body: There are no versions of this front page. No login, no profile, no feed tuned to you. Two strangers who open Void News today see the exact same 50 stories, top to bottom.

posts.caption_instagram:
Two people argue about the news. They are usually arguing about two different feeds, each one assembled privately, for an audience of one.

Void News has one front page. The top 50 stories, in the same order, for every reader on Earth. No accounts, no login, no personalization, no paywall.

You can still disagree. But you will be disagreeing about the same page.

See through the void.

#VoidNews #MediaBias #FilterBubble #SharedReality #NewsLiteracy #OneFrontPage

hook.headline: Your anger is worth nothing to us.

stance.body: Feeds rank by clicks, so outrage wins; it is the cheapest click there is. Void News ranks once a day by how widely a story is covered. Your reaction never touches the order.

posts.caption_instagram:
Outrage is not an accident of modern news. It is a ranking strategy. When a feed is sorted by engagement, the story that makes you furious beats the story that matters.

Void News does not measure engagement. The front page is ranked once a day, by one signal: how widely each story is covered. Nothing you click, share, or rage at changes the order.

When anger stops being profitable, the page gets quieter. That is the point.

See through the void.

news.voidvision.org
#VoidNews #MediaBias #OutrageEconomy #AttentionEconomy #NewsLiteracy #CalmNews

posts.intent: Cool defiance; deny the outrage economy its fuel without raising your voice.

hook.headline: Every bias score shows its work.

stance.body: Each score on Void News comes with a written rationale: which words, which patterns, which track record moved it. Same article in, same score out, every single time. You can check the math.

posts.caption_instagram:
Most bias ratings are verdicts. A panel or a model decides, a label appears, and you are asked to trust it.

Void News scores every source with fixed, rule-based NLP. No AI judging the news. Each score arrives with a deterministic rationale: the words, the patterns, and the track record that produced it.

Run the same article through twice and you get the same score twice. A judgment you cannot reproduce is just an opinion.

See through the void.

news.voidvision.org
#VoidNews #MediaBias #ShowYourWork #NewsLiteracy #Transparency #MediaLiteracy

hook.headline: Left or right is one axis of six.

stance.body: Political lean tells you where an outlet stands, not how it behaves. Void News also scores sensationalism, opinion versus reporting, factual rigor, framing, and a per-topic track record over time.

posts.caption_instagram:
Ask where an outlet sits, left or right, and you have asked one question out of six.

Void News scores every source on six axes: political lean, sensationalism, opinion versus reporting, factual rigor, framing, and a track record kept topic by topic over time. A calm outlet can lean hard. A centrist one can sensationalize.

Every score weighs both the outlet's history and the words in the specific article, and every score explains itself.

See through the void.

news.voidvision.org
#VoidNews #MediaBias #SixAxes #NewsLiteracy #MediaLiteracy #BiasTransparency

hook.headline: We refuse to average a disagreement.

stance.body: Average far-left and far-right coverage and you get a number that looks neutral and describes nobody. On contested stories, Void News shows the real left, center, right split instead.

posts.caption_instagram:
Here is a trick averages play: take coverage from the far left and the far right, add it up, divide, and call the result balanced. The number sits at dead center. Nobody who wrote about the story is standing there.

On contested stories, Void News refuses the average. The page shows the actual split: how many outlets covered it from the left, the center, the right.

A fight is not a compromise. It should not be displayed as one.

See through the void.

news.voidvision.org
#VoidNews #MediaBias #FalseBalance #NewsLiteracy #MediaLiteracy #ContestedNews

hook.headline: Turkey seeks an Interpol red notice for Netanyahu

spectrum.body: Turkey is seeking an international arrest warrant for Israeli PM Netanyahu over the interception of a Gaza-bound aid flotilla, charging genocide. Netanyahu's office called Erdogan an "antisemitic dictator"; Turkey called the response a "groundless rant." 17 outlets, no shared frame.

posts.caption_instagram:
Turkey is seeking an Interpol Red Notice for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, charging genocide and crimes against humanity over the interception of the Gaza-bound Global Sumud Flotilla.

Netanyahu's office called Erdogan an "antisemitic dictator." Turkey called that response a "groundless rant" and a "cheap political ploy."

17 outlets are covering this story, and they do not agree on what it is. Void News shows where each one stands: left, center, right, with every bias score explained.

See through the void.

news.voidvision.org
#VoidNews #MediaBias #Turkey #Netanyahu #Interpol #NewsLiteracy

hook.headline: TikTok pays $400 million over children's privacy

spectrum.body: TikTok will pay $400 million to settle a US DOJ children's privacy lawsuit, one of the largest COPPA recoveries: $300M now, $100M later, no admission of wrongdoing. Coverage splits between a major victory for children and regulatory overreach.

posts.caption_instagram:
TikTok agreed to pay $400 million to settle a US Department of Justice lawsuit over children's privacy, one of the largest recoveries in COPPA history. $300 million now, $100 million later. No admission of wrongdoing.

The case began under Biden in 2024. TikTok's US operations are now 81% investor-owned; ByteDance holds 19%.

29 outlets covered it. Some call it a major victory for children. Some call it regulatory overreach or political. Void News shows the split instead of averaging it away.

See through the void.

hook.headline: One attack in Fagersta. Four different stories.

spectrum.body: An 18-year-old killed a 17-year-old girl and injured two boys in a sword attack at a high school in Fagersta, Sweden. Police are examining a TikTok account posted 20 minutes before, referencing mass murderer Anders Behring Breivik. 29 outlets, four frames: terrorism, mental health, radicalization, immigration.

posts.caption_instagram:
An 18-year-old killed a 17-year-old girl and injured two teenage boys in a sword attack at Brinellskolan high school in Fagersta, Sweden. Police are investigating a TikTok account posted 20 minutes before the attack that referenced past mass-violence attacks and the far-right mass murderer Anders Behring Breivik.

29 outlets covered the same facts. The framings diverge: terrorism, mental health, online radicalization, immigration.

The frame you meet first tends to become the story you remember. Void News puts all four side by side, with each outlet's bias scores shown and explained.

See through the void.
